text: Pelulu
Dunder
Velly
Shawle
Agios
Nicola
[ff6464]Xmas Event has ended.[ffffff]
[ff6464]ERROR：イベント状態を取得できませんでした。
Whoa!? Hey, what's that strange tower!?
Oh, that's true.\nWhen did they build a building like that here...
Seriously? How is it even possible not to notice\nsomething as big as this?
Anyway, just leave me alone!!
Isn't that Velly's voice? It does sound a bit\nrough though.
Yes...It seems that she's been drinking again...
Hey, hey, how much are you gonna drink?\nIt's not good for your health, you know?
Ugh...hic...Just let me be! More water, please!\nShawle, you won't understand how it feels to be\nabandoned at Christmas!
What are you talking about! Anti-Xmas is the\ncounterpart of Xmas in the first place and...wait,\nwhy am I saying this...
Whatever, just leave me alone anyway!!
Ow, ouch! Stop throwing things!
O-ouch! You're gonna be sorry for this, Velly!
You seem to be having quite a bit of trouble too.
If you're here because you're worried about Velly,\nyou're wasting your time. As you can see, she's\nbeen guzzling water for the past few days.
It's strange that she gets rowdy because of that\nthough.
She's lost control of herself indeed.\nShe drives me crazy...
Wouldn't it be better for you if Christmas wasn't\npopular?
Hmph! Having a duel with a shabby Xmas will not\ngratify my pride even if I win!
But seriously, why did Christmas become so\nunpopular?
Because it's just a repetition of the same thing\nevery year. I'm not surprised if people get bored.
The kids seemed to be dissatisfied with the\npresents though.
Of course. The idea of luring people with things\nis terrible in the first place...Hmm?!
Christmas is still popular, you know! Don't you\nknow how long this event has been going on?
Whoa!
You're so naive~.\nAs a merchant, I can tell that you're very naive!
What do you mean?!
Trends change in the blink of an eye, you know?\nThose who don't understand that aren't qualified\nto talk about business.
You need to find out how satisfied people are with\nyour product and prop it up before its popularity\ndrops.
Um...uh...
In fact, it's over when you're the only one who\nthinks it's popular...Huh?
Ugghhh!! I hate you, Pelulu!!
Oh! Lady Velly, please wait for me!
Oops, was I being too harsh?
Well, it's true that the popularity of Xmas has\ndeclined though. You can't do anything about it.
If it's because of the anti-Xmas energy like last\nyear, we may be able to help, but this time...
In that case, could you help us then?
Oh, Agios! Long time no see~!\nNicola, you're here too!
Hmm...
?? What? Why is Nicola acting like that\nsuddenly...?
Uhm...Sorry, I'll explain later. What's more\nimportant now is the current situation of\nNavida City.
The great spirit concluded that the tower that\ncan be seen over there is suspicious after she\nlooked into it.
What's that tower?! When did it show up there?!
Seriously? It's already quite unbelievable that\nDunder didn't notice it, how come even you too?
I've been busy cheering Velly up lately...
It just suddenly appeared overnight a few days\nago, so I'm not surprised if no one noticed it.
So? What's in that tower?
The great spirit is still investigating, but\nanti-Xmas energy waves seem to be emanating from\nthe top of the tower.
Energy waves?
Right. Or maybe you can call them sound waves.\nThe anti-Xmas energy, though greatly diluted,\nis radiating across a broad range.
Those who are exposed to the waves tend to form a\nnegative impression of Xmas easily.
I see. Things are starting to become clear now!
So actually the Xmas knights would like to go and\ninvestigate it immediately, but...
*grumbling* What's so good about the Xmas knights?\nThey're just the laughing stock of the town...
*grumbling* They're trying so hard even though\nnobody expects anything from them. So stupid...
You see, the knights have completely lost their\nmotivation because of the anti-Xmas waves and\nthe criticism from the people in the town.
They could cause a problem in the town if I don't\nkeep an eye on them. So could you please go to\ninvestigate it instead?
Hmm, well, since I also feel bad for making Velly\ncry...
I'm not going! No way I'd help for the sake of\nXmas! Moreover...
Moreover, I haven't slept much as I've been so\nbusy cheering Velly up...
At the end of the day, we still can't tell whether\nhe is a friend or a foe of Xmas.
Well then, I'm counting on you.
We have no choice but to go with the flow.\nShall we?
